description: Shared definitions for Photo Frame Commons contribution records. DEVELOPMENT NAMESPACE: the `.test` top-level domain is reserved (RFC 2606), so this authority is deliberately unownable and must be replaced by a verified-owned NSID authority before any production publication.

problemRef.description: The shared problem this contribution belongs to, named by its canonical app URL and the pinned source repository. Not a claim that the problem was authored on ATProto.

appUrl.description: Canonical deep link to the problem in the publishing app.

localId.description: The app-local stable problem identifier (Postack record id).

repository.description: Source repository the problem's evidence was captured from, e.g. wesbos/photo-frame-dashboard.

revision.description: Source revision or snapshot identifier the evidence was pinned at.

sourceRef.description: A pointer into deliberately captured public source material. The original author stays the author; this record only references it.

digest.description: sha256 of the captured text, when known; a changed digest means changed text.

assistance.description: The submitter's declaration of how the text was prepared. A declaration, never a detection of AI use.

preparedBy.description: Model or tool that drafted the text, when declared.

origin.description: The publishing app's own identity for this record, so the app can recognise its own publication when it reads it back.
